gbm_population_evidence.quote: 3.1.2 Diagnosis: Patients must have a histologically confirmed diagnosis of glioblastoma.

candidate_evidence.quote: Nivolumab will be administered at a dose of 6 mg/kg every 4 weeks (cycle).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: No prior therapy except surgery will be permitted for high grade glioma.

role_evidence.quote: This is open label, multicentre, single arm, pilot study of upfront nivolumab in patients with RRD-glioblastoma with favorable immune/genomic biomarkers.

source_quote.quote: By tumor immunohistochemistry showing functional loss of mismatch repair gene expression (MLH1, MSH2, MSH6, PMS2)

flag.reason: Mismatch-repair deficiency is an entry requirement and is mechanistically linked to checkpoint inhibition, but the record does not state the link explicitly.

source_quote.quote: 3.1.5 Favorable immune markers: High PD1 and CD8 positivity as detailed in the lab manual.

flag.reason: PD-1 positivity is an entry requirement and matches an anti-PD-1 agent, but it is an immune-infiltrate marker rather than a classic predictive biomarker.

coder_notes: Both registered arms are labelled ACTIVE_COMPARATOR but the design is single-group with no control; nivolumab is the only investigational agent. Domain 1 is nivolumab alone; Domain 2 adds radiation at progression, so regimen is coded combination per the 'any radiotherapy in the experimental arm' rule (borderline). Age 12 months to 25 years (CHILD and ADULT), mixed-age population. Condition is registered as 'High Grade Glioma' but inclusion requires glioblastoma.
